verdict.rationale: Datalab documents first-party on-prem deployment: a container, a Helm chart for Kubernetes that has received version updates, and an air-gapped Enterprise option. However, running its models on your own infrastructure requires an Enterprise contract, and only the underlying Marker, Chandra and Surya projects are free open source. missing for 10: self-hosting without an Enterprise contract, documentation that platform features such as pipelines, extraction and webhooks are included in the on-prem build, independent or hands-on corroboration of an on-prem deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Customers can run our models on infrastructure they control with an Enterprise contract.
A Helm chart is available for deploying the container on Kubernetes clusters.
On-premises Helm chart updated to v1.2.0 with refreshed container images.
while Chandra, Marker, and Surya remain free open source
